rounds.text: Chatha Foods Ltd is trading at a notable discount to its intrinsic value, as a discounted cash flow analysis calculates a fair value of ₹ 118 per share compared to the current market price of ₹ 89 [E37]. This creates an attractive margin of safety of 24.6% for investors [E38]. Furthermore, the market's expectations are overly conservative; a reverse DCF demonstrates that the current share price only requires an earnings growth rate of 14.1%, whereas the base case assumes a higher growth rate of 18.0% [E39]. From an asset perspective, the company commands a price-to-book ratio of 2.31x, which compares very favorably to the broader sector benchmark of 3.82x [E7]. Fundamental efficiency is also improving, highlighted by a meaningful expansion in the operating margin from 6% to 8% over a three-year period [E22]. Conceded: [E6].
